name: Cute Cherry Blossom House
description: A pink minecraft house with a stone slab roof, blossom leaves on top and an open front wall. Inside there is one wide room with space for storage and crafting, plus a small pond by the entrance. Built from cherry planks and stone. Fits any grassy spot near a cherry grove.

subBuilds.description: Break the last layer and replace it with cherry planks.
Come to the back side again.
Place a book and quill on the lectern.
Place a clock in the item frame.
